text:
Maria: Quick sync — Lynx Labs case study. We have an interview scheduled with their CTO next Wed. Need quote signoff + legal clearance. Who's owning?

Henry: I'll take PR and social assets. Can someone get me a draft customer quote by EOD Fri?

Glen: I can do asset side but need the signed logo/brand permission + a quote approved. Does legal need an NDA? I thought they already signed something.

legal_team: We have a copy of a standard CLA from 2024 but not a case-study waiver. We'll need either a one-off permission or the customer to confirm quotes. We require a 48h review window for any final quote/language. Also flag any financial/metric claims.

Maria: Cool — @glen can you pull the CLA and confirm? @henry I'll aim to have a rough quote by Thu morning so legal has time.

Glen: Pulling CLA now. Customer timezone note: they're CEST, prefer afternoons there (that's morning PST). Proposed interview slot: Wed 09:00 PST / 18:00 CEST. Is that ok?

Henry: Works for me. I'll draft Qs and share in #marketing-drafts. Thinking social-first narrative around latency/cost wins + developer experience.

Maria: That angle is good, but we need explicit permission to publish latency numbers. @legal_team can we do ranges instead if they won't sign off on exacts?

legal_team: Yes — recommend ranges or customer-provided phrasing. If customer provides a numeric quote, we'll need written approval. No raw SLA claims.

Henry: Draft quote (wip):

"Partnering with Redwood reduced our median generation latency from ~280ms to under 100ms for key workloads, which improved user satisfaction and reduced infrastructure spend." 

I'll flag that for customer approval and mark any numbers as 'customer reported.'

Maria: Nice. @ops-bot can you set a reminder for draft quote due Fri 17:00 PST and another reminder for legal review Mon 09:00 PST?

ops-bot: Reminder set: 'Lynx Labs draft quote due' at 2025-03-07T17:00:00-08:00.
ops-bot: Reminder set: 'Lynx Labs legal review' at 2025-03-10T09:00:00-08:00.

Glen: Also need signed logo usage and a point of contact for approvals — Alex from Lynx said legal@lynx.co is fine. I'll send the approval email after the interview.

Henry: If legal wants to pre-clear any phrasing we can share the one-paragraph hero and the data snippet in advance. Keeps turnaround fast.

legal_team: Agreed. Send the hero paragraph + any metric callouts. We'll confirm within 48h or request edits.

Maria: Great. Summary: Henry owns PR/quote draft, Glen owns asset & logo permission, legal_team owns review. I'll coordinate interview scheduling. Back to you all — I'll post final calendar invite once Alex confirms.

Henry: Thanks! :thumbsup:

Glen: 👍

legal_team: Thanks — will watch for the draft.

Maria: Closing loop — thanks team. Let's aim to publish two weeks after interview, contingent on approvals.
